#284 scope: 'closely related runtime, SCM/Kudu and deployment conceptual diagrams identified by the manifest.' Hosting/container execution, artifact activation and deployment procedures extend the named architecture/request pages; specific network, health and swap views are reviewed individually.

#286 scope: 'health-check/auto-heal, scaling operations, deployment slot swaps and runtime lifecycle pages included in the manifest.' Reliability advice on probe/recovery and process-identity timelines stays with these lifecycle concepts, not incident-specific evidence.

#287 scope: 'All diagrams classified in docs/troubleshooting/, docs/troubleshooting/lab-guides/ and any referenced labs evidence, excluding screenshot/log artifacts.' Preserve typed diagnosis and evidence timelines in their incident context.

#288 scope: 'Start Here, Best Practices not covered above, Language Guides, Operations not covered above, Reference, auxiliary docs and published diagram assets.' Explicit orientation, tutorial, general backup/cost, taxonomy and visual-navigation paths are auxiliary/residual instructional surfaces rather than specialized platform migrations; authoring examples and generated dashboards are excluded separately.

docs/platform/architecture/index.md#scm-.rationale: Reviewed separate main-site and SCM access-rule paths: #285 explicitly distinguishes app site vs SCM network gates; not the generic SCM deployment base of #284.

docs/platform/architecture/index.md#heal.rationale: Reviewed probe result and traffic-rotation decision; #286 names health-check/auto-heal, not the general runtime base of #284.

docs/platform/architecture/index.md#slot.rationale: Reviewed staging warm-up and production swap sequence; #286 explicitly owns deployment slot swaps, preserving sequence semantics.

docs/platform/architecture/index.md#zone.rationale: Reviewed regional frontends distributing traffic across zonal worker groups; #286's plan/instance boundaries extend scaling and resilience rather than the single-instance runtime base.

docs/platform/containers/index.md#regist.rationale: Reviewed ACR/registry authorization choice with managed identity and credentials; #285's networking/identity/dependency scope owns this decision rather than generic container execution.

docs/platform/deployment-scenarios.md#sc.rationale: Reviewed private inbound PE and outbound integrated subnet/dependency topology; #285 owns the actual networking extension despite the deployment page.
Reviewed isolated ASE VNet, internal load balancer and backend subnet boundaries; #285 owns private networking rather than generic artifact deployment.
